title: Kaizen scrape-index item
description: One row in the scrape SQLite index at ~/.claude/.kaizen/scrape/index.db. Produced by scrape_index.py's PocketFlow pipeline (FetchURLs → ScrapeFanOut → Synthesize → EmbedAndPersist). Wraps a ScrapeGraphAI SmartScraperGraph extraction with denormalized text + 384-dim embedding for semantic search.

prompt.description: Extraction prompt the LLM was given. Default: config.SCRAPE_DEFAULT_PROMPT.

title.description: Heuristically-extracted title from the result (looks for 'title'|'name'|'headline'|'page_title' fields).

content_json.description: Raw SmartScraperGraph extraction encoded as JSON. Decoded to a dict on `get`.

text_extract.description: Denormalized flat text from the extraction, privacy-filtered to drop api_key/secret/token/password/auth/credential fields at any nesting depth. Used for embedding + snippet display.

sha.description: 16-hex SHA1 prefix of `url|prompt`. Used for upsert — re-scraping the same (url, prompt) pair replaces the row.

ts.description: ISO UTC timestamp when this row was persisted.

id.description: SQLite primary key. Null before insert.

score.description: Cosine similarity score. Only present in do_search results.
